comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Both build asphalt plants and process equipment for road builders and producers, with aftermarket parts and service; Astec adds aggregate and mining lines.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Road builder and asset operator that uses asphalt plants itself; it does not manufacture and sell plants or process equipment.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: Makes papermaking, wood processing and fluid handling equipment for paper mills and sawmills, a different customer base and product line.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Makes roofing shingles, insulation and glass fiber for building materials markets, not plants or process equipment for asphalt producers.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Builds engines, generator sets and fuel systems for equipment makers; it does not make asphalt plants or burner systems for road builders.
